title: Desk memory v0
description: Eris's memory on this computer (ADR 0095): facts and preferences a person can read and edit, and episodes (what was asked, done and answered) kept beyond a session. Working context is assembled for each turn and never stored. The memory folder holds facts.yaml (MemoryFactsFile), episodes/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl (one MemoryEpisode per line) and a search index derived from both.

MemoryKind.description: A fact or preference, or an episode.

MemoryId.description: fact_ or ep_ and a time-ordered random suffix, so two desks never pick the same id.

MemoryWriter.description: Who wrote an entry: person (through the desk's own screens), eris, a plugin id, or agent:<id> for an agent of the brain (ADR 0072).

MemoryTag.description: A word to group facts by, for example work or tools.

MemoryFact.description: A fact or preference, in words a person reads: "Reviews PRs in the morning". updated is there once it was edited.

MemoryStep.description: One hand-off of the turn an episode records: the command Eris ran and whether it answered (ADR 0089).

MemoryEpisode.description: What was asked, what was done and what was answered in one turn, kept beyond its session.

MemoryHit.description: An entry search found, with the words around the match.

MemoryFactLine.description: A fact as facts.yaml holds it. Only text is needed: a fact a person adds by hand gets an id, a writer (person) and a time when the desk next reads the file, and is written back with them.

MemoryFactsFile.description: facts.yaml in the memory folder: the format version and the facts, oldest first.

version.description: The format version, 0. The desk refuses a file with a version newer than it reads.
